label: 旧内部基线（2026-10-24）
workload: AgentX, public Weka trace, 1800 seconds profiling plus grace/finish
method: TPS P10/P50/P99 and mean copied from the existing 2026-10-24 raw-JSONL audit, which uses per-request (OSL-1)/decode_duration and lower order-statistic percentiles. TTFT percentiles recalculated only from existing compact per-request TTFT values with numpy linear interpolation. No new benchmark.
limitations: Different hosts and vLLM versions from the current archive; historical system comparison, not isolated scheduler gains.
No exact TPS P90/P95 retained in the local audit; do not infer them from last-SSE end timestamps.
TPS mean has extreme short-duration values; use P10/P50 for the comparison.
Synthetic speculative acceptance is not a quality result.
